verdict.rationale: Cua's own SDK creates and drives sandboxed computers on Docker/Podman (gVisor when installed), QEMU, or Lume VMs, and it can start agents inside a Space or sandbox. Cua Driver and connected owned machines then cover pointing the agent at a real device. A hands-on user sandboxed Claude in a Lume VM for days with good results, though an earlier user saw VM connection failures on an old release (0.1.29). Missing for 10: a documented workflow for promoting the same agent from sandbox to real device, and consistent hands-on reliability (WebSocket connection failures, disk-resize not reaching the guest).
